The **Amalgamation's Core** is a fist-sized, pulsing geometric arcane battery that served as the primary power source for the [[Secretive Brotherhood]]'s guardian construct, the [[Amalgamation]].

## Description and Properties
The core is warm to the touch and emits a faint blue light. It represents the pinnacle of the Brotherhood's construct-powering technology, concentrating significant magical energy into a stable, portable form.

## Potential Applications
An intact core can be installed within a large structure, such as a mountain fortress, to power permanent magical defenses—a process requiring a week of work by a skilled artificer. Alternatively, it can be carefully disassembled into its component rare magical materials, yielding enough resources to craft one uncommon magic item for each member of a typical adventuring party.
